fact: The OBR launched the e-KORI platform for online tax filing and the payment of taxes and fees on 19 January 2026.

fact: The OBR launched the implementation phase of E-KORI, a platform for online declaration and payment of taxes and duties, which will let taxpayers pay remotely once fully operational, per the Finance Ministry.

Burundi's finance and digital economy minister said the E-Kori tax collection platform, supported by the World Bank-funded PAFEN project, already allows online payment and online filing for some taxpayers.
Burundi Eco reports the ID for D digitalisation, announced July 2024, will also cover payment of taxes, fines and duties through an electronic e-payment model.
ACO Burundi reports that E-TAXE, begun on 23 August 2024 in twelve pilot communes, collects communal revenue through CRDB Bank's electronic payment terminals, with national extension still to come.

The Burundi Revenue Office (OBR) communiqué says land tax is now managed by OBR and its 2026/2027 declaration must be filed online on UMUTANGAKORI II by 30 September 2026, with payments already made taken into account in the system.
